_comment: Skeptic re-run of the abk-witness census (attempt 001) over a geometrically different search region: offsets 1/89,1/91,1/93 (vs the auto-region 1/97,1/101,1/103), half-width 5/4 (vs 17/16). Region strictly contains the localization ball |x| <= R0 = 1, so by the all-positive localization lemma a census over it is complete even though the tool, given an explicit region, does not claim completeness itself. Every subdivision face is (non-dyadic offset + dyadic), so no symmetric rational point of small height lies on a face. The subdivision tree this induces shares no box with the 001 tree; the certified count must still be 24.
